narr: An upper level low over the Big Bend region combined with a surface low over South Texas to generate thunderstorms. The airmass in which these storms developed was very moist with precipitable water values above the 90th percentile of the long term record. Some of these storms produced locally heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that flooded the intersection of S. Flores St. and SW. Military Dr. in southern San Antonio. There were vehicles stranded in the water.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that flooded I-35 under Nogalitos St. stranding vehicles in the water.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. The San Antonio Fire Department reported several water rescues around the city.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. TXDOT reported RR 187 was closed along the Sabinal River in southeastern Uvalde County.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Several low water crossings across eastern Bexar County were flooded with one to two feet of water.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. TXDOT reported FM 140 was flooded southeast of Uvalde.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. TXDOT reported low water crossings were flooded along FM 1049 around Knippa.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. A low water crossing in Sayers on Macaway Rd. near Rakowitz Rd. was flooded with three feet of water.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. A low water crossing was flooded on Hueco Springs Loop Rd. near Elm Creek Rd. in New Braunfels.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Parker Creek went out of its banks flooding the intersection of CR 422 and CR 425 northeast of D'Hanis.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Several roads were flooded across Caldwell County.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Several roads across Hays County were flooded.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. A low water crossing was flooded on Old San Antonio Rd. near Manchaca.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Williamson Creek left its banks flooding a road in Oak Hill.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Several low water crossings were flooded along Spicewood Springs Rd. in northwestern Austin.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. FM 1322 was flooded by Plum Creek northeast of Luling.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Williamson Creek left its banks and flooded a low water crossing near Joe Tanner Ln. and McCarty Ln. in Oak Hill.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Several low water crossings were flooded along Cameron Rd. near Cele.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Several roads were flooded near Peggy Garner Park to the north and east of New Hope Dr.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. The intersection of FM 1704 and Arbuckle Rd. in Elgin was flooded.

Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. One to two feet of water covered a low water crossing on Grosenbacher Rd. north of Hwy 90 near Potranca Creek on the west side of San Antonio.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that flooded a low water crossing along Bar-J Rd. west of Leon Valley.
